dossier_meta.statement_text: For which values of $r,s$ does there exist an $r$-vertex, $(s+1)$-uniform intersecting hypergraph in which all sets of size $r-s$ contain the same positive number of edges?
dossier_meta.context_text: One of several open questions posed by the authors in Section 4, concerned with the behaviour of $f(n,r,s)$ and/or $g(n,r,s)$.
